lines.text: Many learners say: Please be accurate on the road.
Better: Please be careful on the road.
Careful! Be careful, the floor is wet.

data.wrong: Please be accurate on the road.
data.right: Please be careful on the road.

native.caption: Ты тоже говоришь “Please be accurate on the road”? 😅 Русское «аккуратно» похоже на accurate, но это слово значит «точный». Для «осторожно» нужно “careful.” Правильно: “Please be careful on the road.” Послушай Карлоса и повтори! Больше практики — в приложении Lexkite.
native.comment: Ответ: “careful.” Осторожно — careful. Скажи вслух: “Please be careful on the road.” Бесплатный тест для практики здесь: {link}

en.tip: Not “accurate” but “careful”: “Please be careful on the road.”
en.caption: Do you also say “Please be accurate on the road”? 😅 The Russian word for careful looks like “accurate,” but that word means exact. For being careful you need “careful.” Correct: “Please be careful on the road.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
